# name: Zipacna turned to stone; the boys lure Cabracan with a roasted bird
# title: Vꜩ bala xꜭha curi Zipacna
# fols: fols. 10v–12r
“Vꜩ bala,” xꜭha curi Zipacna, ta xbe cut achbilan chicut ri Zipacna. Xbec, xeopon chuxe zivan; ꜩalam cula ri tap, cacvacavoh vla rih; xe zivan ri cute qui cumaꜩih.

“Vꜩ bala,” chi quicot curi Zipacna, “car ahtah xcoc ta pu chi!” Rumal quiꜩih cuꜩin chi vaih. Xrah cu tih ri; xa xrah hupunic, xrah oquic; pacal curi tap xacanic.

Cate cut xel chu vloc. “Maui xa rico?” xuꜭhax cut. “Mahabi; xa pacalic cacanic; xa nabe zcaquin chic maui mi xnu rico. Cate vꜩlo qui paqueic quin oc vbic,” xꜭha chicut.

Cate cut pacal chic ta xoc vbic. Xquiz cu oc vbic; xa v vi vchec chic xcutun vloc. Xquiz biquitahic, xtilob cu cahoc nima huyub chi vꜭux; maui xꜩolcopih chic; abah cut xuxic ri Zipacna.

Quehe vchacatahic chic Zipacna cumal ꜭaholab Hunahpu, Xbalanque. Ri banol huyub, xꜭha v ꜩihoxic oher, v nabe ꜭahol Vvcub Caquix, chuxe huyub Meauan vbi xchacatah vi. Xa naual xchacatah vi v cab nimarizai rib. Hun chicut xchi ca biyh vbixic.

Rox chicut nimarizai rib, v cab vꜭahol Vvcub Caquix, Cabrracan vbi. “In yohol huiub,” xꜭha.

Xavi cu xere Hunahpu, Xbalanque xchacou re Cabrracan. Xꜭha ri Huracan, Chipi Caculha, Raxa Caculha, ta xꜭhauic chiquech ri Hunahpu, Xbalanque:

“V cab vꜭahol Vvcub Caquix hunchic, hunchic chi chacatahic; xavi nu ꜩih, rumal maui vꜩ qui banoh chuvach vleuh, ca qui couizah ꜫih chi nimal, chi alal; ma cu quehe chuxic. Chi bochiyh cu vbic chila relebal ꜫih,” xꜭha cut ri Huracan chique ri e caib ꜭaholab.

“Vꜩ bala, lal ahau; que vi na cut. Maui vꜩ vi ca quilo. Ma pa lal ꜭolic, lal pu yacalic, lal Vꜭux Cah?” xeꜭha cut ri ꜭaholab, ta xqui culuba vꜩih Huracan.

Are puch ca tahin ri Cabrracan iohol huyub; xa zcaquin chutinih racan chuvach vleuh, huzu chi bulih nima huiub, chuti huyub rumal.

Ta xculutah cumal ri ꜭaholab. “Apa cat be vi, at ꜭahol?” xeꜭha chirech ri Cabracan. “Mahabi quin be vi; xa in vliy huyub; in puch yohol rech chi be ꜫih, chi be zac,” xꜭha cut, ta xꜭhauic.

Xꜭha chicut ri Cabrracan chique ri Hunahpu, Xbalanque: “Hupacha xpetic? Maui vetaam vvach. Naquipa ibi?” xꜭha Cabrracan.

“Mahabi ca bi; xa oh vbom, xa pu oh ꜩarabom pa tac huyub; xa oh meba, mahabi naquila quech, at ꜭahol. Xa chuti huyub, xa nima huyub coh bec, at ꜭahol. Are curi hun nima huyub xquilo; xa co quil caquiye; quiꜩih naht cacanic, xa ca cupupic qui couic chuvi huyub ronohel. Ma cu habi hun caib ꜩiquin mi xca cam chuvach, at ꜭahol. Ve cut quiꜩih ca vulih ronohel huiub, at ꜭahol?” xeꜭha ri Hunahpu, Xbalanque chire Cabrracan.

“Ma quiꜩih xivilo ri huiub qui biyh? Apa ꜭo vi? Xchi vil na, xchin vulih cahoc. Apa xivil vi?” “Chila ba ꜭo vi chi relebal ꜫih,” xeꜭha cut Hunahpu, Xbalanque.

“Vꜩ. Chi cama ca be,” xe vꜭhax cu ri e caib chi ꜭaholab. “Mahabi; xa ca chape nicah chi ca xol, cut ꜭohe vi hun cha mox, hun cha vi qui cab chique, rumal ꜭo ca vvb. Ve ꜭo ꜩiquin chi ca vvbah,” xeꜭha cut.

Que quicot chi qui tihtobela qui vvbanic. Are curi ta que vvbanic, mana vleuh tah vbac qui vvb; xa chi cuxlabih ri ꜩiquin ta chi qui vvbah. Chu maihah curi Cabracan.

Ta xqui bac cu qui cac ri ꜭaholab; xqui bol cut qui ꜩiquin chuvach cac. Hun cut ꜩiquin xqui cul zahcab chirih; zaqui vleu xqui coho.

“Are cut chi ca ya chire ta hiconoc, ta chu ꜩica puch ruxlab. Ca ꜩiquin ta chacahoc. Are curi vleuh xchoc chirih ꜩiquin cumal; puleu chi ca ꜩac vi, quehe cat puvleu chi muc vi. Ve nima etamanel hun ꜩac, hun bit ta chanax oc, ta zaquir oc,” xeꜭha ri ꜭaholab.

“Rumal xax chi rain vi vꜭuxlal ri chi tihic, chi chacuxic, quehe xchu raih vꜭux ri Cabracan,” xeꜭha chi quibil quib Hunahpu, Xbalanque.

Ta xqui bol ri ꜩiquin; xchacah cut ꜫan vbolic, chi yipouic, chi cabchiyanic quih ri ꜩiquin, chi coinic zimizoh ruxlab.

Are curi Cabrracan cu rraih chic rechaxic; xa cauahin vvaal pu chi, xa cabiquilahic, ca curulah puch vchub, vcaxah rumal vzimzohil ꜩiquin. Ta xuꜩonoh cut: “Naquipa ri iuecha? Quiꜩih cuz ruxlab ca nu nao. Chi ya ta zcaquin vech,” xcha cut.

Ta xya cut hun ꜩiquin chire Cabracan, vchacatahic curi. Catecut xuquiz ri ꜩiquin, ta xbe chicut, xeopon cu chila relebal ꜫih, ꜭo vi ri nima huyub.

Are curi Cabracan xa tubul chic racan vcab; mabi chi couin chic, rumal ri vleu xcul chirih ꜩiquin xutio. Ma cu habi chic naquila xu ban chic chire huyub; maui xuꜩinic xu vlih tah.

Ta xim cut cumal ꜭaholab; chirih xim vi v cab; xrilih vcab cumal ꜭaholab; xim cut vcul racan vcabichal. Catecut xqui tarih cahoc puleu, xqui mucu.

Quehecut vchacatahic Cabracan ri xavi xere Hunahpu, Xbalanque; maui ahilan qui banoh varal chuvach vleuh.

Are chicut xchi ca biyh chic calaxic Hunahpu, Xbalanque; are nabe mi xca biyh ri qui chacatahic Vvcub Caquix, ruc Zipacna, ruꜭ Cabracan, varal chuvach vleuh.
